name: gizza-ai/csv-stats
summary: Per-column summary statistics for a CSV.

tool.description: Compute per-column summary statistics for a CSV: each column's value count, empty-cell count, number of distinct values, and (for columns whose values are all numeric) min, max, mean, and sum. Returns the stats per column plus the row count. delimiter is a single char or comma/tab/semicolon/pipe. Runs locally.

header.description: Treat the first row as a header for column names (default true).

delimiter.description: Field separator: a single char or 'comma'/'tab'/'semicolon'/'pipe'. Default ','.
